description: Contracts for pilot reports (docs/pilots/<id>.json) and release evidence (releases/<version>/), enforced by .agents/lib/release.py.

contexts.small-team: At least one human and one agent.
contexts.team: At least two humans using at least two supported CLIs.

blocker_categories.data-loss: A framework operation lost or overwrote user data.
blocker_categories.incorrect-gating: A mandatory gate passed when it should have failed, or could not run.
blocker_categories.authentication-bypass-claim: Something was reported as authenticated or verified when it was not.
blocker_categories.matrix-test-failure: A test failed on a supported operating system and Python version.
blocker_categories.broken-install-update-recovery: A documented installation, update, or recovery path does not work.
